title: Easy clean up.
text:
Easy clean up.. Well made lids, no leaking at all. The lid seal is easy to remove to clean. The dish is the perfect size for a left over meal.
UPDATE OCT 2019: I have had two lids crack from the cold in the freezer, company doesn't sell replacement lids

product_metadata.title: Bayco Large Glass Food Storage Containers with Lids, [12 Piece] Glass Meal Prep Containers, Airtight Glass Bento Boxes, BPA Free & Leak Proof (6lids & 6Containers)(Square & Rectangle)
features: [6 PACK GLASS CONTAINERS] Our glass containers include 2 different types and 6 sizes:Rectangle container:1x630ml(2.7 cups),1x1040ml(4.5 cups),1x1500ml(6.4 cups),Square container: 1x530ml(2.3 cups),1x800ml(3.4 cups),1x1100ml(4.7 cups) (Please allow 0.1-0.3 inch in differs due to manual measurements, your understand will be much appreciated) The BAYCO glass containers are versatile,perfect for a variety of occasions and events:gym,leftovers,picnic,portion control,work lunches,travel,and more

[OVEN,MICROWAVE(Not the lids),DISHWASHER SAFE /FREEZER SAFE] These containers are oven safe below 752℉, you can use them for freezer storage,microwave(not the lids)and dishwasher, easy to use and easy to clean. It's safe to wash the lids in the dishwasher, but high temperatures over a long period of time can deform the silicone sealing strip at the edge of the lid, please wash the lids by hand as much as possible

[BPA FREE] Bayco Glass Storage Containers are BPA Free, which will maintain the freshness and keep your food odorless. It's made out of borosilicate glass for easy heating and durability, and in order to prevent the rubber seal sticking to the glass containers, please must wash the lids and glass containers before put them away

[LEAK PROOF MEETS YOUR NEEDS] These glass containers will be a good helper for serving your daily food storage needs,not only are these good for dry foods but also great for holding liquids such as juice,soup and more.The snap locking system forms an airtight and watertight seal,never food spilling over again.you can use them over and over again. Please handle with care and do not stack containers without separating by plastic layer or something else to avoid friction and breakage

[QUALITY CUSTOMER CARE] BAYCO offer a full day after-sales service. If you are not satisfied with your products or receive cracked products,please contact our store, we will provide the best solution to refund or resend within 24 hours
